title: Lecture 3: Linux Command Line Interface (CLI) Fundamentals
arabicSummary:
الجزء الأول: واجهة المستخدم (UI) 🖥️

واجهة المستخدم (UI) هي النقطة اللي بيحصل فيها التفاعل والتواصل بين الإنسان والكمبيوتر.

ما هو الـ "Shell"؟

الـ Shell هو برنامج بياخد الأوامر منك (عن طريق الكيبورد) ويديها لنظام التشغيل عشان ينفذها. حاليًا، فيه نوعين من الـ Shell:

  • GUI (Graphical User Interface): الواجهة الرسومية اللي بنستخدم فيها الأيقونات والأزرار والماوس.
  • CLI (Command Line Interface): واجهة سطر الأوامر اللي بنكتب فيها أوامر نصية.

لماذا نحتاج سطر الأوامر (CLI)؟

  • بعض المهام لا يمكن تنفيذها إلا عبر CLI (مثل الإعدادات المتقدمة للخادم).
  • الـ CLI أسرع وأكثر كفاءة في إنجاز المهام المتكررة (Automation).
  • قدرة على عرض تفاصيل دقيقة ومعلومات خلفية عن النظام.
  • قدرة على إدارة النظام عن بعد بكفاءة عالية (Remote Access).

الجزء الثاني: أساسيات سطر الأوامر (CLI) ⌨️

الجزء ده بيعرفك على أهم الأوامر الأساسية في التعامل مع النظام والملفات والمجلدات.

1. الأوامر الأساسية:

  • whoami: بيعرفك مين هو المستخدم اللي شغال حاليًا.
  • pwd: بيعرض لك المسار الكامل للمجلد اللي أنت واقف فيه دلوقتي (Present Working Directory).
  • ls: بيعرض محتويات المجلد اللي أنت فيه (Files and folders).

2. الانتقال داخل النظام:

  • cd: أمر تغيير المجلد (Change Directory). ده أهم أمر عشان تتحرك بين المجلدات.
  • cd ..: بيرجعك خطوة للمجلد اللي كان قبله.
  • cd ~: بيرجعك للمجلد الرئيسي الخاص بالمستخدم الحالي (Home Directory).
  • cd /: بيرجعك لجذر النظام (Root Directory) وهو أعلى مكان في كل الملفات.

3. الحصول على المساعدة:

  • man [command]: بيعرض لك كتيب المساعدة الكامل (Manual Page) لأي أمر.
  • مفتاح الخروج: للخروج من صفحة الـ man، اضغط على حرف q (اختصار لـ Quit).
englishSummary:
Part 1: The User Interface (UI) 🖥️

The User Interface (UI) is the point where interaction and communication occur between a human and a computer.

What is the "Shell"?

The Shell is a program that takes commands from you (via the keyboard) and passes them to the operating system for execution. Currently, there are two types of Shells:

  • GUI (Graphical User Interface): The graphical interface where we use icons, buttons, and the mouse.
  • CLI (Command Line Interface): The command-line interface where we type text commands.

Why do we need the Command Line (CLI)?

  • Some tasks can only be performed via CLI (such as advanced server settings).
  • The CLI is faster and more efficient for repetitive tasks (Automation).
  • Ability to display precise details and background information about the system.
  • Ability to manage the system remotely with high efficiency (Remote Access).

Part 2: Command Line Fundamentals (CLI) ⌨️

This part introduces you to the most essential commands for interacting with the system, files, and folders.

1. Basic Commands:

  • whoami: Tells you who the currently logged-in user is.
  • pwd: Displays the full path of the directory you are currently in (Present Working Directory).
  • ls: Lists the contents of the current directory (Files and folders).

2. Moving Within the System:

  • cd: The Change Directory command. This is the most important command for moving between directories.
  • cd ..: Moves you one step back to the parent directory.
  • cd ~: Returns you to the current user's main directory (Home Directory).
  • cd /: Returns you to the Root Directory, the highest level in the entire file system.

3. Getting Help:

  • man [command]: Displays the full Manual Page (help documentation) for any command.
  • Exit Key: To exit the man page, press the q key (short for Quit).

quiz.question: 1. What does the acronym CLI stand for?
quiz.englishHint: Abbreviation for the command-line interface.

quiz.question: 2. What is the main function of the 'Shell'?
options: To take user commands and pass them to the OS
quiz.correctAnswer: To take user commands and pass them to the OS
quiz.englishHint: It is the interface between you and the Kernel.

quiz.question: 3. Which command shows you the current user's identity?
quiz.englishHint: From its name: 'who am I'.

quiz.question: 4. The pwd command displays the:
quiz.englishHint: Abbreviation for 'Print Working Directory'.

quiz.question: 5. Which command is used to list the contents of a directory?
quiz.englishHint: Abbreviation for 'List'.

quiz.question: 6. The cd command is used to:
quiz.englishHint: Abbreviation for 'Change Directory'.

quiz.question: 7. What does the cd .. command do?
options: Moves to the user's home directory
Moves one level up (to the parent directory)
quiz.correctAnswer: Moves one level up (to the parent directory)
quiz.englishHint: The two dots always mean the parent directory.

quiz.question: 8. Why is the CLI often preferred for advanced server management?
options: It offers greater control and is more efficient for remote access
quiz.correctAnswer: It offers greater control and is more efficient for remote access
quiz.hint: التحكم عن بعد بيكون أسهل وأسرع.
quiz.englishHint: Remote control is easier and faster.

quiz.question: 9. Which command provides detailed help documentation for another command?
quiz.englishHint: Abbreviation for 'Manual'.

quiz.question: 10. What does the command cd ~ do?
options: Moves to the user's Home Directory
quiz.correctAnswer: Moves to the user's Home Directory
quiz.hint: علامة التيلدا (~) بترمز للمجلد الرئيسي للمستخدم.
quiz.englishHint: The tilde symbol (~) refers to the user's home directory.

quiz.question: 11. A key advantage of using CLI is its ability to automate tasks, known as:
quiz.hint: كتابة الأوامر في ملف واحد عشان تتنفذ لوحدها.
quiz.englishHint: Writing commands in a single file to be executed automatically.

quiz.question: 12. What is an example of a GUI element?
quiz.englishHint: The graphical interface relies on visuals.

quiz.question: 13. What is the full path for the Root Directory in Linux?
quiz.englishHint: The single slash symbol.

quiz.question: 14. If you are in `/home/abdullah` and run cd .., where will you be?
quiz.englishHint: Moving one step back to the parent directory.

quiz.question: 15. What is another term for GUI?
quiz.englishHint: It relies on sight and images.

quiz.question: 16. Which of the following is NOT a reason to use the CLI?
options: Changing desktop wallpaper with a mouse
quiz.correctAnswer: Changing desktop wallpaper with a mouse
quiz.hint: هذه مهمة يتم إنجازها عادةً في الواجهة الرسومية.
quiz.englishHint: This task is typically completed in the graphical interface.

quiz.question: 17. To move directly to the highest level of the file system (Root), which command is used?
quiz.hint: العلامة دي بترجعك لأصل النظام كله.
quiz.englishHint: This symbol takes you back to the root of the entire system.

quiz.question: 18. How do you exit the man command details page?
quiz.englishHint: Abbreviation for 'Quit'.

quiz.question: 19. CLI is also known as a 'console user interface' or...
quiz.englishHint: Because it relies on characters.

quiz.question: 20. Another reason to use the CLI is...
options: To know more details in the background
quiz.correctAnswer: To know more details in the background
quiz.hint: بتوريك حاجات بتحصل في الخلفية مش بتظهر في الـ GUI.
quiz.englishHint: It shows you things happening in the background that don't appear in the GUI.
